本路线用同一组六个置换贯穿九节：先重排与共轭，再比较子群，最后构造表示并解释简并: The same six permutations connect nine lessons: rearrangement and conjugacy, subgroups, representations, and degeneracy. Operations act actively on column vectors; gh applies h first. Representations are finite-dimensional and complex. The S₃ class order is **e, three transpositions, two three-cycles**, with class sizes **1, 3, 2**. Some D₃ tables use another order, so match operations before comparing columns.
三顶点标量基的置换表示记为 D。取 u₀=(1,1,1)/√3、u₁=(2,−1: Let D be the permutation representation on three scalar site bases. With u₀=(1,1,1)/√3, u₁=(2,−1,−1)/√6, and u₂=(0,1,−1)/√2, D splits into A₁ and E blocks. S₃ is isomorphic to D₃; this route uses abstract permutations and does not identify a transposition directly with a spatial reflection.
## 1. 重排定理：群平均为何不依赖起点: ## 1. Rearrangement: why group averaging is independent of the starting point
固定 a∈G，映射 g↦ag 是双射：若 ag₁=ag₂，左乘 a⁻¹ 得 g₁: For fixed a∈G, the map g↦ag is bijective: ag₁=ag₂ implies g₁=g₂ after multiplying by a⁻¹, and x has preimage a⁻¹x. Left or right multiplication therefore reorders the full group without adding or omitting elements. Commutativity is not required. See the [rearrangement theorem in MIT's introductory notes](https://symm4ml.mit.edu/symm4ml_s26/notes/intro-to-groups).
**演示与证明：**选一个置换 a，对比原列表、ag 和 ga；逐格找出对应关系: **Demonstration and proof:** Select a and compare the original list with ag and ga, matching entries. Explain ∑g f(ag)=∑g f(g) through this substitution, then use it in group averaging. The step is a change of summation variable, not arbitrary deletion of a.
共轭映射 g↦hgh⁻¹ 保留乘法结构。S₃ 中三类为 {e}、{(12),(1: Conjugation g↦hgh⁻¹ preserves multiplication. The S₃ classes are {e}, {(12),(13),(23)}, and {(123),(132)}. For permutations it relabels cycle entries: (123)(12)(123)⁻¹=(23). Conjugate matrices in a representation are similar and have equal traces. See the explicit S₃ examples in [CMI Math Methods of Physics, §13, p. 46](https://www.cmi.ac.in/~govind/teaching/math-meth-e24/math-phys-notes-gk-2024.pdf).
**演示与证明：**固定 g，遍历 h 并收集不同结果；从 D(hgh⁻¹)=D: **Demonstration and proof:** Fix g, vary h, and collect distinct results. Use D(hgh⁻¹)=D(h)D(g)D(h)⁻¹ to show that a character is constant on a conjugacy class. Equal characters for two elements alone do not prove conjugacy.
## 3. 正规子群：何时可以组成商群: ## 3. Normal subgroups: when cosets form a quotient group
A₃={e,(123),(132)} 在任意共轭下保持不变，是 S₃ 的正规子群: A₃={e,(123),(132)} is invariant under every conjugation and is normal in S₃. H={e,(12)} is not: conjugating by (123) produces (23), outside H. Normality requires hHh⁻¹=H for every h∈G, not just elements of H. See the [CMI examples of A₃ and cosets](https://www.cmi.ac.in/~govind/teaching/math-meth-e24/math-phys-notes-gk-2024.pdf).
**演示与证明：**比较两种子群的左、右陪集。A₃ 的两个陪集按奇偶性组成 S₃: **Demonstration and proof:** Compare left and right cosets for both subgroups. The two A₃ cosets form S₃/A₃≅C₂ through permutation parity. Cosets of H exist, but do not form a quotient group under the usual coset multiplication.
## 4. 字符自内积：不可约与重复拷贝: ## 4. Character self-inner-product: irreducibility and repeated copies
定义归一化内积 ⟨χ,ψ⟩=|G|⁻¹∑g χ(g)*ψ(g)。若 Γ=⊕α m: Define ⟨χ,ψ⟩=|G|⁻¹∑g χ(g)*ψ(g). For Γ=⊕α mαΓα, irreducible-character orthogonality gives ⟨χΓ,χΓ⟩=∑αmα². A nonzero representation is irreducible exactly when this self-inner-product equals 1. It is the squared norm. For orthogonality and class-size weights, see [University of Alberta, §2.8](https://sites.ualberta.ca/~vbouchar/MAPH464/section-characters-orthogonality.html).
**演示与证明：**三顶点表示 χ=(3,1,0) 的自内积为 (9+3)/6=: **Demonstration and proof:** The three-site character χ=(3,1,0) has self-inner-product (9+3)/6=2, consistent with A₁+E. For E, χ=(2,0,−1) gives (4+2)/6=1. A value of 2 means a sum of squared multiplicities, not a two-dimensional representation.
## 5. Schur 引理：哪些矩阵可以与全部操作对易: ## 5. Schur's lemma: matrices commuting with every operation
在复不可约空间中，若 A 与全部 D(g) 对易，则 A=cI。证明可取 A 的: In a complex irreducible space, A commuting with every D(g) implies A=cI. Choose an eigenvalue c of A: ker(A−cI) is nonzero and invariant, so irreducibility makes it the whole space. Intertwiners between inequivalent irreps vanish. For commuting matrices and equivalent copies, see [MIT's finite-group notes, §6](https://symm4ml.mit.edu/symm4ml_s26/notes/representations).
**演示与证明：**在 E 块中改变候选 A 的元素，检查所有对易子。对 A₁+: **Demonstration and proof:** Vary a candidate A within E and inspect all commutators. For A₁+E, two scalars can be chosen independently. With equivalent E copies, an operator may also mix the copies. Do not extend the scalar conclusion from one irreducible block to the entire reducible space.
## 6. 群平均度量：非幺正外观不等于不能幺正化: ## 6. An averaged metric: making a representation unitary
对任意有限群复表示，取 M=|G|⁻¹∑g D(g)†D(g)。M 正定，重排定: For a finite-group complex representation, take M=|G|⁻¹∑g D(g)†D(g). It is positive definite, and rearrangement gives D(h)†MD(h)=M. With S=M¹ᐟ², U(g)=SD(g)S⁻¹ obeys U(g)†U(g)=I. This changes the inner product or basis; a unitary similarity alone cannot change the original singular values. See [Etingof et al., Introduction to Representation Theory, §4.6, pp. 71–72](https://math.mit.edu/~etingof/reprbook.pdf).
**演示与证明：**先对标准 E 表示施加一个非正交可逆换基，观察普通欧氏长度不: **Demonstration and proof:** Apply an invertible nonorthogonal basis change to standard E and observe that ordinary Euclidean lengths need not be preserved. Construct M and check length invariance in the averaged metric.
每类不等价不可约表示选定一组幺正正交基后，∑g Dαᵢⱼ(g)*Dβₖₗ(g)=: Choose an orthonormal unitary basis for each inequivalent irrep. Then ∑g Dαᵢⱼ(g)*Dβₖₗ(g)=|G|/dα δαβδᵢₖδⱼₗ. For E in S₃, each matrix-element vector has squared norm 6/2=3, and distinct matrix-element vectors are orthogonal. See the basis conditions and proof in [Etingof et al., §4.7, pp. 72–73](https://math.mit.edu/~etingof/reprbook.pdf).
**演示与证明：**将一个矩阵元在六个操作上的取值排成向量并逐项相乘求和；再换一: **Demonstration and proof:** List one matrix element over all six operations as a vector and compute the sums, then select another element. Nonorthogonal basis changes preserve a representation but need not preserve this Euclidean orthogonality formula. First unitarize the basis or use the appropriate metric.
## 8. 约化公式与维数平方和：两种不同的计数: ## 8. Reduction and the sum of squared dimensions: two different counts
本表三行是 A₁:(1,1,1)、A₂:(1,−1,1)、E:(2,0,−1)。: The rows are A₁:(1,1,1), A₂:(1,−1,1), and E:(2,0,−1). Using class sizes 1, 3, 2 in mα=∑c n_cχα(c)*χΓ(c)/6 gives multiplicities (1,0,1) for the three-site representation and dimension 1+2=3. In contrast, ∑αdα²=|G| concerns the complete set of inequivalent irreps: here 1²+1²+2²=6. It is not the dimension formula for an arbitrary representation. See [Alberta, §2.8.3](https://sites.ualberta.ca/~vbouchar/MAPH464/section-characters-orthogonality.html).
**演示与证明：**将同一组数分别用于三顶点表示和六维正则表示。正则表示分解为: **Demonstration and proof:** Compare the three-site representation with the six-dimensional regular representation A₁+A₂+2E. Distinguish irrep dimension d from occurrence multiplicity m, and explain why class-size weights are necessary.
若量子哈密顿量在所选有限对称群下不变，Schur 引理限制其在单个不可约块中的作: If a quantum Hamiltonian preserves the chosen finite group, Schur's lemma makes its action on a single irrep scalar. An isolated E block therefore gives a symmetry-protected doublet. With m copies of E, symmetry permits H=Hmultiplicity⊗I₂: copies may mix and have different energies while each branch remains twofold. This follows from the [Schur commutant structure](https://symm4ml.mit.edu/symm4ml_s26/notes/representations).
**演示与证明：**比较保持全部群操作的扰动与破坏对称性的扰动，追踪 E 双重态: **Demonstration and proof:** Compare symmetry-preserving and symmetry-breaking perturbations while following E doublets. Irrep dimension describes a protected multiplet, not the whole reducible space. Different irreps can also coincide accidentally in energy. Problems involving spin, antiunitary symmetries, or space-group little groups require the appropriate extended representations; this example is not an exhaustive account of degeneracy.
先固定群和作用空间，再写矩阵、基底与内积；检查群乘法后，才比较特征标、正交关系、: Fix the group and representation space, then specify matrices, bases, and inner products. Check multiplication before characters, orthogonality, decomposition, and energy levels. The finite demonstrations replay key substitutions or invariant-subspace arguments; they do not replace the general proofs.
